result:
All tests pass (`11 ok, all tests passed`). One note: a temporary spot-check script I created at `/Users/vitor/.cache/flashnext-concurrency/claude-work/spotcheck.sh` (outside the repo) couldn't be deleted because the sandbox denied `rm` outside the working directory — feel free to remove it.

Summary of the changes:

- **`rotate.sh`** — fixed the rotation: the guard is now `total -le keep` (nothing to do at exactly N), and surplus is the first `total - keep` lines of the ascending list (`head -n`), so the **oldest** archives are deleted and the newest N survive. Its option-parsing block and `resolve_dir` now come from `lib/common.sh`.
- **`verify.sh`** — fixed sidecar parsing: `read -r expected file <<< "$line"` takes the whole remainder of the shasum line as the file name, so names with spaces verify correctly; the digest comparison is now a quoted `[[ ]]`. Same switch to `lib/common.sh`; all flags (`--dest`, `--name`, `-q`, `-h`, `=forms`, `--`) behave as before, verified by spot-check.
- **`lib/common.sh`** (new) — the shared option parser, `--keep` validation, and `resolve_dir`, sourced as `source .../lib/common.sh "$@"` after `usage`/`parse_local_option` are defined (double-source guard like `lib/log.sh`).
- **`tests/run_tests.sh`** — added a verify test for `my backup-….tar.gz` (ok, rc=0), and a rotate group covering `--keep 3` with 4 archives (oldest deleted, newest 3 kept, sidecars removed) and with exactly 3 (nothing deleted).

Changed files: `rotate.sh`, `verify.sh`, `tests/run_tests.sh`, plus new `lib/common.sh`.
